title: Fourier component by coordinate projections
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\iota$ be finite nonempty sets, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $(\psi_a)_{a\in\iota}$ be a basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ that contains the constant-one function and is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product. For $n\in\mathbb N$, a function $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, and $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the Fourier component supported on $S$ is $\sum_{J\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|J|}P_Jf$, where $P_Jf$ is the function obtained by fixing the coordinates in $J$ and averaging over all other coordinates using $\pi^n$.
hypotheses_covered: Basis is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
